name: Tietasaura
sum: An elasmarian ornithopod from the Early Cretaceous Marfim Formation of Brazil, known from a single incomplete femur and the first ornithischian named from Brazil.
wsnote: Not given in the sources used.
holotype: The distal end of a left femur, collected near Salvador, Bahia, in the 19th century (specimen number not read).
biology: Known only from one bone; no biology is described in the sources consulted.
author: Bandeira et al. 2024

sources.text: K. L. N. Bandeira, B. A. Navarro, and R. V. Pêgas, N. S. Brilhante, A. S. Brum, L. G. de Souza, R. C. da Silva, V. Gallo. 2024.
